# betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_git (Resource)

Manages a Generic Git Service Connection within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_git" "example" {
  project_id            = betterado_project.example.id
  service_endpoint_name = "Example Generic Git Service Connection"
  description           = "Managed by Terraform"
  repository_url        = "https://github.com/example/repo.git"
  username              = "myuser"
  password              = "mypassword"
  enable_pipelines_access = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `repository_url` (String) The server URL of the GenericGit git service connection.
- `service_endpoint_name` (String) The Service Endpoint name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The Service Endpoint description.
- `enable_pipelines_access` (Boolean) A value indicating whether or not to attempt accessing this git server from Azure Pipelines.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The password or token key to use for the GenericGit git service connection.
- `username` (String) The username to use for the GenericGit service git connection.

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Map of String) Specifies the authorization scheme and parameters.
- `id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint.
